title: 3dRetinoPhase
description: Process time series from retinotopy stimuli to create phase datasets and visual field angle datasets

dataset.description: Time series from a retinotopy stimulus.
dataset.title: Dataset

clw.description: Clockwise moving polar angle mapping stimulus.
clw.title: Clockwise Polar Angle

ccw.description: Counterclockwise moving polar angle mapping stimulus.
ccw.title: Counterclockwise Polar Angle

spectra.description: Output amplitude and phase spectra datasets.
spectra.title: Spectra

nrings.description: Number of rings in the stimulus. Default is 1.
nrings.title: Number of Rings

nwedges.description: Number of wedges in the stimulus. Default is 1.
nwedges.title: Number of Wedges

ort_adjust.description: Number of DOF lost in detrending outside of this program.
ort_adjust.title: Detrending DOF Adjustment

pre_stim.description: Blank period, in seconds, before stimulus began.
pre_stim.title: Pre-Stimulus Period

sum_adjust.description: Adjust sum of angles for wrapping based on the angle difference. Default is 'y'.
sum_adjust.title: Sum Adjustment

ref_ts.description: 0 lag reference time series of response for DELAY phase estimation method.
ref_ts.title: Reference Time Series

multi_ref_ts.description: Multiple 0 lag reference time series. This allows you to test multiple regressors.
multi_ref_ts.title: Multiple Reference Time Series
